player_prompt.intro: Wena unguMdlali {player_id} ku-SimpleTak. Ebhodini, amatshe akho avele njengo '{player_stone}' namatshe omphikisi wakho avele njengo '{opponent_stone}'. Ngesikhathi sakho, khetha ikheli elilodwa elingenalutho (ngenombolo yalo) bese ubeka itshe lakho lapho. Isibonelo, '[12]' ubeka itshe lakho esitokisini 12. Inhloso yakho ukwakha indlela eqhubekayo yamatshe akho axhuma imiphetho emibili ephambene yebhodi (phezulu kuya phansi noma kwesobunxele kuya kwesokudla).

invalid_move.cell_out_of_range: Inombolo yekheli engekho emthethweni {cell_num}. Kumele ibe phakathi kuka-0 no {max_board_num}.
invalid_move.cell_already_occupied: Iseli {cell_num} selivele lihlala. Khetha iseli elingenalutho.
